title: iot.anomaly.detected
description: One event per detected anomaly episode on a warehouse sensor. Published by the anomaly-detection service to the Kafka topic named after event_type (iot.anomaly.detected), partition key = payload.sensor_id. Delivery is at-least-once and a crash replay re-publishes the same episode with a NEW event_id, so consumers must de-duplicate on payload.episode_id, not event_id. Consumers must ignore unknown fields so additive changes do not break them.

event_id.description: UUID v4, unique per published event.

event_version.description: Schema version number (integer 1). Additive, backward-compatible changes keep version 1.

occurred_at.description: UTC wall-clock time the event was created. Sensor time is in the payload.

episode_id.description: Deterministic id: sensor_id|window_start, where window_start is ISO-8601 UTC with a +00:00 offset (Python isoformat). Treat it as an opaque string; do not rebuild or reformat it. The same episode always has the same id; use it to de-duplicate.

warehouse_id.description: Canonical warehouse id (city IATA code), e.g. WH-BLR-01.

severity.description: Producer-assigned urgency, ordered low < medium < high < critical. Treat it as an ordered label only; the exact rule is owned by the anomaly service.

message.description: Human-readable one-line summary, ready to show in an alerts panel.

window_start.description: UTC sensor time of the first flagged reading of the episode.

window_end.description: UTC sensor time of the last flagged reading of the episode.

first_flag_time.description: UTC sensor time of the first flagged reading.

confirmed_time.description: UTC sensor time when the episode was confirmed (minimum flagged readings reached, or one severe reading).

peak_time.description: UTC sensor time of the highest-scoring reading. top_features explain this reading.

peak_score.description: Highest anomaly score in the episode. Higher = more anomalous.

threshold.description: Anomaly threshold in force at the peak reading. Score >= threshold is anomalous.

n_flagged.description: Number of flagged readings in the episode.

severe.description: True if at least one reading was far above the threshold.

closed_by.description: quiet = no flags for the gap period. shutdown = flushed while still open; a later event may continue the same incident.

top_features.description: SHAP explanation of the peak reading, ordered by contribution, highest first. Normally only features that push toward anomaly (shap_value > 0). If no feature does, contains exactly one item: the least-normal feature with contribution 0.

contribution.description: This feature's share of the positive SHAP push (0 to 1).

shap_value.description: Signed SHAP value on the anomaly score; positive pushes toward anomaly.

direction.description: Feature value above (high) or at/below (low) its training mean.
